title: Adopt workspace-rooted Memory Bank layout
context: Multiple repos share the agent; we need a predictable root path per workspace for managed files and logs.
decision: Use a workspace-scoped root (.memory-bank/) with a single index file and subfolders for notes, logs, and artifacts.
alternatives: Store next to each repo root
consequences: Requires explicit init/select step when workspace changes

title: Store decision log as append-only entries plus render step
context: Users want a readable decisions.md, but the agent needs structured entries for tooling and re-renders.
decision: Persist decision entries as JSON rows; render to decisions.md on demand or after successful writes.
alternatives: Write only JSON and never render

title: Normalize file IDs separate from filesystem paths
context: Renames and migrations break direct path references in logs and context.
decision: Reference managed files by stable mbf_* IDs; store current relative_path in the file table and resolve at runtime.
consequences: Requires lookup when reading by ID

title: Set rendering to be best-effort with retry queue
context: Occasional FS locks on Windows and CI containers cause render failures; we still want durable decisions.
decision: Mark entries as logged if render fails and enqueue a maintenance job to retry rendering later.
consequences: Avoids lost entries on transient failures

title: Use UTC ISO-8601 timestamps for all logs
context: Workspace collaborations span time zones; mixed local timestamps made ordering and diffs confusing.
decision: Store created_at/updated_at in UTC with ISO-8601; UI layers may localize for display.
consequences: Slightly less human-friendly in raw JSON

title: Cap free-text fields to 200 chars in structured logs
context: Long summaries bloated diffs and increased token usage when the agent loaded memory context.
decision: Enforce a 200-character limit for context/decision excerpts in structured entries; store longer detail in files.
consequences: Some detail must move to notes files

title: Support filename migration with mapping manifest
context: We need to rename legacy files (e.g., progress.md -> progress-log.md) without breaking references.
decision: Add a migration manifest recording old->new relative paths and update managed-file records accordingly.
consequences: Requires careful ordering to avoid partial moves

title: Handle UMB commands via idempotent completion markers
context: UMB command processing can be retried; repeated executions caused duplicate side effects in file ops.
decision: Write a completion marker per command (hash + timestamp) and skip already-completed commands.
alternatives: Only allow commands in interactive mode
consequences: Needs periodic cleanup of old markers

title: Retract decision to auto-update active context on every progress write
context: Auto-updating active context created noisy churn and occasionally pinned stale context when writes failed mid-run.
decision: Retract the prior behavior; active context updates must be explicit or triggered only on milestone events.
consequences: Less churn and fewer stale pins
Requires callers to opt in when needed

title: Treat rate-limited storage ops as retryable, not fatal
context: Some environments throttle file API calls; failing hard left the memory bank partially updated.
decision: Classify 429/locked-file conditions as retryable and back off with jitter; preserve last known good state.
alternatives: Disable managed files in throttled envs

title: Expire stale render targets when decisions.md was deleted
context: Users sometimes delete decisions.md manually; subsequent renders wrote to a missing/renamed file ID reference.
decision: If the rendered file ID cannot be resolved, clear rendered_file_id and set status back to logged for re-render.
alternatives: Hard fail and require manual repair
consequences: May surprise users who expected old file to stay removed

title: Archive old maintenance decisions into monthly rollups
context: Decision logs grew large; most older maintenance notes are rarely referenced but useful for audits.
decision: Render monthly rollups and retract individual low-value maintenance entries after rollup is published.
